choices.content: Both pairs of corresponding legs are equal
One acute angle and the hypotenuse are respectively equal
The hypotenuse and one leg are respectively equal
One acute angle and one leg are respectively equal

question.prompt: For two right triangles, which of the following conditions requires using HL to establish their congruence?

solutions.explanation: Here, interpret “requires using HL” as asking which criterion applies directly to the given data. A allows SAS using the equal right angles, B allows AAS, and D allows ASA or AAS. C gives equal corresponding hypotenuses and one pair of equal corresponding legs, which are precisely the HL conditions. Therefore, the answer is C under this interpretation. This does not claim that HL is the only possible proof after deriving additional facts.
solutions.title: Compare directly applicable criteria
